## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows Conventional Commits (it becomes the squash commit message)
- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `npm test` passes
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] Docs updated if behaviour, the API contract or the data model changed (`docs/`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under **Unreleased**
- [ ] No secrets, keys or real `.env` values committed
- [ ] UI changes checked at 375 px and desktop width, in light and dark mode
